comment: Dialogue. Story Bible: Director Bertram Pike speaks in budget numbers.
notes: Code generated with AI assistance (Claude). Reviewed by team. Lines Director Pike says in the Rocket Builder when the player bumps into the budget. Placeholders: {cost} = what the rocket would cost, {budget} = the budget, {left} = money left before the change, {over} = how far over. All in millions of USD, already formatted with one decimal. The builder picks a line at random from each list.
over_budget: ${over}M over. I don't have ${over}M. Nobody in this building has ${over}M.
Washington gave us ${budget}M, not ${cost}M. Put it back.
clamped: Stop there. ${left}M left, and it stays left.
Far enough. The rest costs money we don't have.
budget_cut: The budget's ${budget}M now. Your rocket is ${cost}M. Fix it before you ask me for a launch.
Washington cut us to ${budget}M. That rocket doesn't fly until it costs less.
